summary: Mint Inc Ltd (Mint Incorporation Limited) filed a Form 6-K reporting it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The company was previously notified of non-compliance on December 19, 2025, and had until June 17, 2026, to cure. After 10 consecutive business days (May 6–19, 2026) with closing bid prices at or above $1.00, Nasdaq confirmed compliance. This is a routine exchange compliance update, not a special situation. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 registration statement.
